influence_notes: Commands the executive branch and military and issues executive orders; proposes the budget and can veto it but Congress appropriates; appoints the Cabinet and judges with Senate consent; sets the national agenda.
Formal powers are limited to presiding over the Senate and breaking ties. Succession and any duties delegated by the President are not counted.
